info.title: Coffee Management API - staff administration, typed settings and immutable audit
info.description: Auth/catalog/orders/payments/inventory plus admin staff management, token revocation, last-operational-admin protection, allow-listed typed operational settings, and immutable administrative audit logging. Inventory deployment gate defaults false; historical flags immutable. Real external provider adapter remains unconfigured (503); no real KHQR/callback, refund, report or split payment.

post.description: Public login. Role determined by database. Five requests/minute per normalized email+IP and thirty/minute per IP, including success/invalid input. Generic 401 for invalid, inactive, unassigned or unrecognized-role identity. Email/device_name trimmed; email lowercased; password not trimmed. Unknown top-level request fields rejected.

post.summary: Atomically create an unpaid pending order
post.description: All active POS staff. Authoritative USD prices, zero tax/discount. Deployment inventory.tracking_enabled defaults false; new tracked orders require active recipes/available stock and atomically snapshot/reserve. Old key replays original order/tracking even after config changes. Same intent200, changed intent409; invalid/insufficient stock422; no payment/provider I/O.

post.summary: Persist external attempt before provider I/O
